data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Constant_True

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_Plus
data.value: Adds the value of one numeric expression to another, or concatenates two strings.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_Minus
data.value: Finds the difference between two numbers.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_Multiply
data.value: Multiplies the value of two expressions.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_Divide
data.value: Divides the first operand by the second.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_Modulo
data.value: Returns the remainder (modulus) obtained by dividing one numeric expression into another.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_BitwiseOr
data.value: Compares each bit of its first operand to the corresponding bit of its second operand. If either bit is 1, the corresponding result bit is set to 1. Otherwise, the corresponding result bit is set to 0.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_BitwiseAnd
data.value: Performs a bitwise logical AND operation between two integer values.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_BitwiseXor
data.value: Performs a logical exclusion on two Boolean expressions, or a bitwise exclusion on two numeric expressions.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_Equal
data.value: Returns true if both operands have the same value; otherwise, it returns false.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_NotEqual
data.value: Returns true if the operands do not have the same value; otherwise, it returns false.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_Less
data.value: Less than operator. Used to compare expressions.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_LessOrEqual
data.value: Less than or equal to operator. Used to compare expressions.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_GreaterOrEqual
data.value: Greater than or equal to operator. Used to compare expressions.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_Greater
data.value: Greater than operator. Used to compare expressions.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_In
data.value: In (,,,) Tests for the existence of a property in an object.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_Like
data.value: Compares a string against a pattern. If the value of the string matches the pattern, result is true. If the string does not match the pattern, result is false. If both string and pattern are empty strings, the result is true.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_Between
data.value: Between (,) Specifies a range to test. Returns true if a value is greater than or equal to the first operand and less than or equal to the second operand.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_And
data.value: Performs a logical conjunction on two expressions.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_Or
data.value: Performs a logical disjunction on two Boolean expressions.

data.name: ExpressionEditorStringId.Operator_Not
data.value: Performs logical negation on an expression.
